## Known biases

Jamaica Bay watershed only. A model product (about 50 m grid, no buildings, no explicit sewers, one lumped drain rate), not an observation, calibrated and scored on a handful of high-water marks, so its 0.20 m is an in-sample figure. The 8 or 18 marks behind it are not independent of the USGS set used elsewhere in this study.
